unsupported: Seattle-Tacoma Box Company has operated from Kent, Washington since 1889, making it one of the oldest continuously family-owned packaging firms in the Pacific Northwest.
Capabilities include custom structural design, printing, and die-cutting for produce bins, shipping containers, and retail-ready packaging.
While specific facility dimensions and headcount are not disclosed, the combined operations serve high-volume agricultural harvest cycles across the region.
Primary customers are growers, packers, and shippers in the fruit, vegetable, and seafood sectors throughout Washington, Oregon, and California.
